recipes.name: Judy's Hot Cocoa inspired by the Santa Clause
instructions: For the Basic Hot Chocolate
In a small bowl, combine a couple of tablespoons of heavy cream to the cocoa powder and sugar. Whisk together until a paste has formed. - 3 tbsp cocoa powder - 3 tbsp sugar
In a medium saucepan, combine milk and heavy cream over medium-low heat bringing up to just before simmering. - 1 cup milk - 1 cup heavy cream
At 190°F, kill the heat and add in the chocolate and cocoa paste. Whisk together until melted and homogenous. - 4 oz chocolate
Season with kosher salt and optionally add in vanilla extract and instant espresso powder. Whisk together. - 1 tsp vanilla extract (optional) - 1 tsp instant espresso powder (optional) - Kosher Salt
Once everything is mixed in, serve, and enjoy.
For the French Hot Chocolate
In a medium saucepan, combine milk and heavy cream over medium-low heat bringing up to just before simmering. - 1 cup milk - 1 cup heavy cream
Add in brown sugar and dark chocolate. Whisk together until melted and homogenous. Kill the heat and stir together until melted. - 1 tbsp brown sugar - 8 oz dark chocolate
Season with a pinch of kosher salt. Whisk together before serving. - Kosher salt
For the Italian Hot Chocolate
In a small bowl, combine cocoa powder, sugar, and cornstarch. Whisk together until a paste has formed. - 3 tbsp cocoa powder - 3 tbsp sugar - 1 tbsp cornstarch
In a medium saucepan, combine milk and heavy cream over low heat bringing up to just before simmering. - 1 cup milk - 1 cup heavy cream
Add in the cocoa powder mixture, whisk together for a couple of minutes before adding dark chocolate. Whisk together until pudding-like. - 4 oz dark chocolate
Pour into a glass and serve.
For the Vienna Hot Chocolate
In a bowl, whisk together sugar with egg yolks. - 3 tbsp sugar - 2 egg yolks
In a medium saucepan, combine milk and heavy cream over medium-low heat bringing up to just before simmering. - 1 cup milk - 1 cup heavy cream
Add in dark chocolate. Whisk together until melted and homogenous over low heat. - 8 oz dark chocolate
Slowly ladle in the chocolate mixture to the eggs while whisking constantly before adding back into the pot.
Cook over medium-low heat for 1-2 minutes until a little bubbling starts.
Serve and enjoy.
For the Ultimate Hot Cocoa

In a bowl, combine sugar with Valrhona and Ghirardelli cocoa powder along with a pinch of instant espresso powder and a pinch of salt. Whisk together. - 3 tbsp sugar - 2 tbsp Valrhona cocoa powder - 2 tbsp Ghirardelli cocoa powder - Instant espresso powder - Kosher salt
In a medium saucepan, combine milk and heavy cream over low heat bringing up to just before simmering. - 1 cup milk - 1 cup heavy cream

In an insulated thermos, add in the cocoa powder along with dark chocolate and through a funnel pour in the steaming milk and cream. Give a gentle shake. ***do not try this at home*** - 2 ½ oz dark chocolate
Very carefully untwist the top to release the pressure and pour into the nearest mug. Enjoy.
